title: Snippet: StrMenu from Enum list
summary: This post demonstrates an AL code snippet that uses StrMenu to let users select from a filtered subset of enum values dynamically, useful when all enum values should be visible normally but only certain values are allowed in specific scenarios.
key_points: Uses a List to collect allowed enum values dynamically rather than statically defining them on a page field
Automatically selects and returns the only value if the filtered list contains just one item
Formats enum values for the StrMenu by converting them to text and handling comma separators
Returns an error if no values are found or if the user cancels the menu selection
